title: Hissatsu Pachinko Collection
native_title: 必殺パチンコ・コレクション
overview:
Six machines in all, including Dance Dance 2 and Aladdin, faithfully ported!!

Hissatsu Pachinko Collection brings six real pachinko machines from makers Daiichi and Fuji to the Saturn. Pick a machine, fire balls into the playfield and aim for the payout pockets that set off the reels and big wins. In normal mode, mahjong is also on hand as a sub-game.

- Machines: Dance Dance 2, Areddin, CR Big Sorotter 2, Sunrise, Excite and Arrange Man
- Mahjong sub-game
- 1 player
- Memory backup

ダンスダンス2、アレジン等、計6種類を移植!!
